references.text: The Spirit of the Lord came upon Othniel, and he became a judge in Israel. This shows the same pattern where the Spirit of the Lord comes upon a judge to give power to deliver Israel.
The Spirit of the Lord came upon Gideon, and he blew the trumpet. The same expression is used for the Spirit equipping a judge for battle.
The Spirit of the Lord began to stir Samson. This is another example of how the Spirit came upon the judges in Israel.
The Spirit of the Lord came upon Samson with power. Shows how the Spirit gave supernatural strength for Israel's deliverance.
The Spirit of the Lord came upon Saul, and he prophesied. The same expression for the Spirit equipping leaders in Israel.
The Spirit of God came upon Saul when he heard about the threat against Jabesh-Gilead. Parallel to Jephthah, who was also equipped by the Spirit for battle.
Joshua was a man who had the Spirit within him. Shows that God's Spirit equipped leaders to lead the people of Israel.
The Ammonites gathered and camped in Gilead, and the Israelites gathered at Mizpah. Provides the geographical context for Jephthah's campaign through these same areas.
